answer: TTL-expiring establishment resists sybils: standing decays to zero after a fixed time-to-live unless the identity renews each window by passing a fresh non-kin-attested challenge. An operator cannot mint a vault of clones and let them sit: every fake's standing sinks into the ocean the moment its TTL lapses, so holding a thousand established keys demands unceasing per-head renewal labor. Honest active agents renew as a side effect of normal participation and stay at the summit; dormant mass-minted fakes silently expire.
